title: Allicin suppressed Escherichia coli-induced urinary tract infections by a novel MALT1/NF-kappaB pathway.
authors: Chang, Zhenglin; An, Lingyue; He, Zhican; Zhang, Yuyan; Li, Shujue; Lei, Min; Xu, Peng; Lai, Yongchang; Jiang, Zheng; Huang, Yapeng; Duan, Xiaolu; Wu, Wenqi
one_liner_zh: 该文研究大蒜素通过MALT1/NF-kappaB通路抑制大肠杆菌尿路感染，仅涉及小分子-蛋白对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Escherichia coli (E. coli) strains cause the majority of urinary tract infections (UTIs) and are resistant to various antibiotics. Therefore, it is imperative to explore novel host-target therapies. As a famous food and condiment, garlic (Allium sativum L.) is widely used in medicine, but its exact key targets in UTIs remain elusive. To identify the major active ingredient of garlic and its molecular target against UTIs, a network pharmacology analysis was carried out, and allicin was revealed to be a key active component in garlic acting on UTIs. By molecular docking, allicin showed a good binding affinity to mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue lymphoma translocation protein 1 (MALT1). The possible regulatory mechanisms of allicin against UTIs were based on the modules of immune and inflammatory responses mainly through AKT/NF-kappaB signaling. Next, an E. coli-stimulated human uroepithelial cell (HUC) model was established to confirm the anti-infective effect of allicin. The results showed that allicin could significantly inhibit the upregulation of MALT1, the AKT/NF-kappaB pathway, and cytokines (IL-6 and IL-1beta). HUCs pretreated with the PI3K inhibitor or transfected with MALT-siRNA also partly suppressed the activation of the AKT/NF-kappaB pathway and cytokines. Furthermore, by establishing the PCA algorithm to evaluate the therapeutic score, allicin was proved to achieve the optimal therapeutic effects compared with the PI3K inhibitor and siRNA-MALT1. Moreover, in rats with an E. coli-induced UTI model, allicin significantly alleviated the infection and up-regulation of MALT1 expression in the bladders, a marked increase in the bacterial load of urine, and deviations in serum biochemical parameters. In conclusion, allicin exerts anti-infective effects in UTIs mainly via the MALT1/NF-kappaB axis or AKT/NF-kappaB pathway, which provides a theoretical basis for understanding the function of allicin against UTIs and facilitates its clinical application.
abstract_zh: 大肠杆菌（Escherichia coli, E. coli）菌株引起大多数尿路感染（urinary tract infections, UTIs），并对多种抗生素具有耐药性。因此，探索新型宿主靶向疗法势在必行。作为一种著名的食品和调味品，大蒜（Allium sativum L.）在医学中被广泛使用，但其在UTIs中的确切关键靶点仍不明确。为鉴定大蒜的主要活性成分及其对抗UTIs的分子靶点，进行了网络药理学分析，结果显示大蒜素（allicin）是大蒜中作用于UTIs的关键活性成分。通过分子对接（molecular docking），大蒜素对黏膜相关淋巴组织淋巴瘤易位蛋白1（mucosa-associated lymphoid tissue lymphoma translocation protein 1, MALT1）表现出良好的结合亲和力。大蒜素对抗UTIs的可能调控机制主要基于免疫和炎症反应模块，主要通过AKT/NF-kappaB信号通路实现。接下来，建立了大肠杆菌刺激的人尿路上皮细胞（human uroepithelial cell, HUC）模型，以确认大蒜素的抗感染效果。结果表明，大蒜素能显著抑制MALT1、AKT/NF-kappaB通路及细胞因子（IL-6和IL-1beta）的上调。用PI3K抑制剂预处理或转染MALT-siRNA的HUCs也部分抑制了AKT/NF-kappaB通路及细胞因子的激活。此外，通过建立PCA算法评估治疗评分，证明大蒜素与PI3K抑制剂和siRNA-MALT1相比能达到最佳治疗效果。而且，在大肠杆菌诱导的UTI大鼠模型中，大蒜素显著减轻了膀胱中的感染和MALT1表达上调、尿液中细菌载量的显著增加以及血清生化参数的偏差。总之，大蒜素主要通过MALT1/NF-kappaB轴或AKT/NF-kappaB通路在UTIs中发挥抗感染作用，这为理解大蒜素对抗UTIs的功能提供了理论基础，并促进了其临床应用。
